tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search for flight deals between two airports on a given date. Returns cash fares and/or award availability from multiple sources (Duffel, SerpApi, Seats.aero).

tools.name: search_calendar
tools.description: Find the cheapest travel dates around a target date. Shows a calendar view of minimum prices for flexible date travelers.

tools.name: get_prediction
tools.description: Get a buy/wait/neutral recommendation for a flight fare based on historical patterns and time-based signals.

tools.name: optimize_points
tools.description: Compare points redemption options for a flight and rank them by cents-per-point (CPP) value. Helps decide whether to pay cash or use loyalty points.

tools.name: check_hidden_city
tools.description: Check for hidden city ticketing opportunities where booking a flight through your destination is cheaper than booking directly. Includes important risk disclaimers.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: Browse current award travel deals and flight promotions.
